repository.name: agid-postal-cn
repository.purpose: China postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.assignment_rule: China has used a four-level six-digit postcode system since 1986. China Post compiles codes under rules of the State Post Bureau, and the UPU sheet places six digits before the province while showing delivery-region and destination-county coding context. Production assignment requires an exact current operator or competent-authority artifact with postcode, typed postal object, jurisdiction, validity, retrieval time, schema and digest pinned. A UPU example, code prefix, format match, outlet lookup instruction, coordinate, model or third-party map does not create a current assignment.
postal_system.universal_delivery_address_code_rule: GB/T 41832-2022 defines a separate universal delivery address coding system. State Post Bureau describes it as a high-precision code containing country or region, satellite-navigation-system and delivery-location components with optional enterprise or item attributes. It is not the six-digit postcode, an AGID cell, a public address corpus or automatically invertible public geometry. Store code_type, standard version, authority, validity and rights separately; never translate between systems by pattern or model alone.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A six-digit postcode is not guaranteed to be a polygon. Never generate official postal geometry from code digits, prefix hierarchy, destination county, post-office coverage, an address or Tianditu point, administrative containment, road network, OSM feature, proximity, Voronoi, interpolation, machine learning or a real-time model. Official point, polygon or multipolygon requires an exact China Post or competent-authority artifact explicitly relating the typed postcode to that geometry and pinning authority, jurisdiction, validity, CRS, topology, licence and digest. Derived validation surfaces stay independently labelled and cannot fill unknown coverage as official.
postal_system.address_format_rule: The UPU 09/2013 sheet documents Chinese big-to-small order and Latin or Pinyin small-to-big order, plus province, subordinate administrative levels, street, premises, compound, building, floor, door, P.O. Box and poste-restante elements. These are display and parsing semantics only. Dated examples, a formatted string or geocode do not establish a current civic address, building relation, resident or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.standard_address_rule: GB/T 39609-2020 supplies address-geocoding semantics and the 2022 Geographical Names Regulation establishes standard names and local standard-address responsibilities. A production standard address or doorplate must come from the exact competent local authority or rights-cleared resource with identifier, jurisdiction, validity, script, transliteration, retrieval and rights pinned. National legal frameworks do not publish an open national doorplate corpus.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires an explicit rights-cleared standard address or doorplate identity, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building point or footprint geometry with purpose, authority, jurisdiction, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. Postcode, universal delivery address code, geocode, Tianditu result, real-estate unit number, parcel, administrative polygon, coordinate, OSM footprint or proximity is not an automatic address-building relation.
postal_system.tianditu_rule: Tianditu is the national geospatial public-service portal and may provide place-name, address, map and geocoding services. Every exact API, layer or product requires owner, key or quota, terms, attribution, map-review and security obligations, jurisdiction, validity, CRS, topology and digest to be pinned. Free online service and portal visibility are not a blanket licence to harvest or redistribute address, building, map or postal data.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Typed postcodes, permitted address points, derived surfaces and explicitly linked buildings may connect to AGID cells only through versioned crosswalks without relabelling a postcode, universal delivery address code, standard address, building, parcel, administrative area or territory as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is official China Post geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: China Post, UPU, State Post Bureau, national-standard catalog, geographical-name regulation, Tianditu and real-estate query pages are reference or legal framework sources unless an exact reusable resource and rights are pinned. UPU POST*CODE data can be separately licensed. Tianditu services and layers require exact product terms. Real-estate materials are purpose-limited. ODbL data remains separate. Pin every resource, terms version, attribution, override, access rule and digest before promotion.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Postal queries, universal delivery address codes, doorplates, exact coordinates, entrances, floors, rooms, recipients, residents, owners, occupants, property rights, real-estate units, accounts, API keys and query logs may expose household, property, security or personal context. They are excluded from public artifacts unless lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postcodes, code types, assignments, standard names, administrative context, addresses, doorplates, buildings, service responses and crosswalks are time-dependent. Store code_type, valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, source version and supersession independently; never silently rewrite historical evidence or promote a cached real-time response without its observation time.
postal_system.territorial_rule: Country code CN selects a runtime and source contract; it is not a sovereignty, jurisdiction, administrative-boundary or universal-coverage assertion. CN, HK, MO and TW packs remain technically separate, and no data is merged across them by label or proximity. Province or equivalent, local authority, source jurisdiction, validity, script, licence and coverage must be explicit. No postal, government, map, third-party or community source is presumed to cover every area or settle boundary status.

stages.definition: A source-attested current national China Post six-digit routing-assignment edition with typed assignment objects, exact technical jurisdiction, stable identities, validity and exceptions; independently licensed point or area geometry with explicit assignment relations, reviewed CRS and topology; separate standard-address and civic/building-link review; exact source and terms SHA-256, reproducible transformations and coverage validation, approved immutable published artifacts and real AGID descriptor/loader/API verification. Outlet locations, formatting examples, a universal delivery address code, map access, synthetic tests or a directory total cannot satisfy this criterion.
